comment_changes.before:
/** * GT6's berry bush logic ({@code MultiTileEntityBush}). * *

GT6 grows a bush every 128 ticks by {@code mSpeed} increments, where {@code mSpeed} is 1 on * plantable ground, plus the same amount again when it is raining, or — under a roof — when the light * level is above 9. A stage advances whenever GT6's byte-sized growth counter overflows, i.e. every * 256 increments ({@code if (++mGrowth == 0) mStage++}), which its own comment calls out as a * deliberate quirk. The port keeps all of it: 128-tick cycles, one stage per 256 increments, the * rain and light bonuses. */
comment_changes.after:
/** * GT6's berry bush logic ({@code MultiTileEntityBush}). * *

The shared rules retain the 128-tick growth cycle and byte-sized counter rollover: one stage * advances per 256 growth increments. Rain and light inputs currently come from modern Level * queries; their environment contracts differ from the original GT6 helpers and are audited * separately. This entity also maintains the current fixed-species identity and legacy migration. */
